spec.kitLine: last bullet -> Burst Skill CD ▼1.56s, allies
spec.assertion: Structural: exactly one lastBullet/allies block with burstCdr seconds 1.56, no gate, not oncePerBattle. Behavioural: full-burst count strictly drops when the burstCdr effect is stripped, and strictly drops when the target is re-scoped to self — so it fails under the nearest-wrong target set (self-only), the nearest-wrong trigger (structural pin rejects shotFired/burstCast), and under omission.

Structural: one lastBullet/allies block, buff partsDamagePct value 50.68, durationSec 5, carrying at least one window gate. Behavioural non-vacuity: buffApply(partsDamagePct) count > 0 AND strictly less than the same block with its gates cleared — fails under the nearest-wrong 'ungated, every magazine' model and under a gate so tight it never fires. Inertness: totals deep-equal with the buff stripped (partless scope-lock boss).

Structural: one enemy-targeted INTERVAL block, single flatDamage effect, atkPct 216, flavor distributed, core falsy, noFb falsy. Behavioural: contribution > 0 and exactly linear (doubling atkPct adds the same amount removing it takes away, ratio 0.9–1.1) — fails if the 216% is not applied per proc or if a second hidden source exists. Cadence bound (3–199 skill2 damage events) rejects shotFired/hitCount keying. Inertness: teammate totals byte-identical when stripped.

it.skip — no engine primitive shortens an interval trigger's cadence for a window (burstCdr reduces BURST cooldowns only). The burst's main amplification (S2 procs during the 10s window) is therefore either hand-authored as extra effects or missing; unassertable without a new primitive.

Structural: hasPierce must NOT be true and exactly one gainPierce effect with durationSec 10 must exist in the burst slot — fails under the nearest-wrong whole-fight hasPierce:true flag (which would tag pierce from t=0). Behavioural: totals deep-equal with gainPierce stripped, documenting that pierce carries no damage in this comp (pierceDamagePct is inert in v1 and no teammate consumes it).

Structural: exactly one burstCast/enemy flatDamage with atkPct 8900.83, flavor distributed, delaySec ≈ 10, core falsy, noFb falsy — fails under (a) an instant hit at cast (loses the 'once the duration ends' semantics and the buff snapshot at landing), (b) a hardcoded noFb exemption instead of letting the 10s landing decide FB exposure, (c) a core-tagged payload. Behavioural: payload delta > 0 and halving the cap halves the delta (0.45–0.55) — fails if the payload is not a single linear-in-atkPct hit per burst.

spec.kitLine: Brand accumulates damage up to the cap
spec.assertion: it.skip — the engine has no damage-accumulation channel, so the modelled payload is always the 8900.83% MAXIMUM. Any 10s window in which the team deals less than the cap is over-credited; the magnitude of that over-credit is unmeasurable in-sim.

fixtures: controlComp('dorothy', true) — liter B1 / crown B2 / dorothy in the carry slot / helm B3, deterministic (no seed), 11 hoisted 180s runs. dorothy is BURST I, so she shares the B1 stage with liter and the stock rotation may hand every B1 cast to liter, leaving her burst blocks unexercised; all burst-slot assertions therefore run on a variant fixture that pushes a damage-free { kind:'burstFirst' } block onto her burst slot (changes only WHO wins the B1 slot — adds no damage, buff, or trigger), guaranteeing non-vacuity. skill1/skill2 assertions run on the stock control comp. helm is kept (helm=true) because a real B3 is required for the chain to complete at all — a comp without one makes ZERO full bursts, which would void every full-burst-count assertion.
gaps: burst — Manifestation 'Cooldown of Skill 2 ▼18 sec for 10 sec': no primitive shortens an interval trigger's cadence for a window (burstCdr is burst-cooldown-only), so the burst's core amplification is unmodellable as written.
burst — Brand's accumulate-to-cap mechanic: no damage-accumulation channel exists, so the payload can only be dealt at the 8900.83% cap (⚑ optimistic; over-credits any window that deals less).
skill2 — the interval SECONDS are a datamined skill cooldown, absent from the kit prose (⚑); the test pins the trigger KIND only.

burst — Gain Pierce is behaviourally unobservable in this fixture: pierceDamagePct is inert in v1 and no comp member consumes a Pierce tag, so only the encoding (gainPierce durationSec 10, not hasPierce) and its damage-inertness can be asserted.
skill1 — Damage to Parts ▲ is inert on the partless scope-lock boss; correctness is asserted structurally plus by gate-bite event counts, never by damage.
